description.value: Wendel's Bookstore & Cafe is a well-established local institution in the historic village of Fort Langley, pairing a working bookstore with a full-service cafe that serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner using locally sourced BC ingredients. The heated covered patio overlooks the picturesque village, and the in-house bakery produces fresh desserts daily alongside a full espresso bar featuring Moja coffee, BC wines, and craft beers. Fort Langley is a popular cycling destination on the scenic Fraser River, making this a natural rest stop for touring riders.
